deletion.title: Unsubscribe from Influweb / withdraw consent
deletion.warning:
If you unsubscribe from Influweb / withdraw consent, your account data will be deleted.
After the account has been deleted, we will no longer be able to link information you have provided (such as age and symptoms) to you.
